In detail

Press research on Liesing, Vienna's southernmost and largely suburban/residential district, turned up no violent crime, drug-scene or no-go-area coverage. District crime statistics for 2024 show mainly property and cyber offences typical of a residential outer district: vehicle break-ins rose sharply (285 cases, up from 118) alongside internet fraud (521 cases) and bicycle theft, while residential and cellar burglaries actually fell year-on-year (meinbezirk.at, May 2025). The only recurring local-safety topic in district council coverage is youth groups gathering at Liesinger Platz near the train station, which prompted calls for streetworkers and possible CCTV in 2024 — but the district police chief explicitly stated there are no crime 'hotspots' in Liesing (meinbezirk.at, Apr 2024). No specific incidents or safety concerns relevant to travellers were identified for either day or night. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, "Kriminalstatistik: Diebstahl, Einbrüche und Internetbetrug in Liesing" (6 May 2025); meinbezirk.at, "Politik in Liesing: Das Thema Sicherheit ist im Fokus der Bezirksvertretung" (2 Apr 2024).
